name: library-cover-maker
description: Makes animated cover art for your Jellyfin libraries. Add up to 5 videos or pictures, type the library name, and download an animated WebP that cuts between random moments from each, with a frame and the name in a big serif font. Pick files from your computer or straight from your media folders on the server. The covers are made in your browser, and nothing is sent anywhere else.

paths.name: Media
paths.description: Your media folder, read-only. The web UI's Server media button lets you pick videos and pictures from here. Use the same folder Jellyfin uses.

paths.name: Extra media
paths.description: Optional second folder, read-only. Shows up as a folder called extra in Server media.

ports.name: WebUI
ports.description: Port for the Library Cover Maker web UI. Jellyfin uses 8096, so the default is 8097.
